$comment: WP41 section 4.3: one machine-readable manifest for Exercises 1-12. Generators and tests validate book links and JupyterLite deployment against this file instead of duplicating route strings. WP49 deploys Exercises 1-8's JupyterLite migrations to production (see feature/wp44-colab-portability-exercise-3, WPs/reports/WP44_REPORT.md; feature/wp45-active-exercises-4-and-5, WPs/reports/WP45_REPORT.md; feature/wp46-active-exercises-6-and-7, WPs/reports/WP46_REPORT.md; feature/wp47-active-exercise-8-unsupervised-learning, WPs/reports/WP47_REPORT.md; WPs/reports/WP49_REPORT.md) with the author's explicit authorization while real-Colab acceptance of the revised notebooks remains separately pending -- migrationState=migrated here reflects what is actually published, not a claim that the Colab gate (WP41_MAINTAINER_GUIDE.md section 11) has passed. WP52 adds Exercise 9 to the published, migrated set on the same basis (WPs/reports/WP52_REPORT.md). WP57/WP57R built Exercise 12 ('Common Mistakes and Pitfalls') locally; this release (WPs/reports/WP57_RELEASE_REPORT.md) publishes it to the same migrated set, again with real-Colab acceptance separately pending. Exercise 11 stays migrationState=legacy -- not migrated, no lite wiring -- with its book page a titled placeholder stub ('Exercise 11: Embeddings and RSA'), clearly marked 'coming later', with no runnable notebook or launch/download button. WP58 built a from-scratch Exercise 10 ('Deep Learning') notebook, Colab/local-Jupyter-only by design (PyTorch has no wheel for this course's pinned JupyterLite/Pyodide build -- verified directly, see WPs/reports/WP58_REPORT.md); WP59 publishes it: Exercise 10 stays migrationState=legacy (no lite wiring, by design -- it must never appear in the in-browser notebook launcher) but its book page at book/chapters/chapter_10/placeholder.md (filename unchanged for minimal diff; content replaced) now offers a real download and an 'Open in Colab' link instead of the old 'coming later' stub text. legacyStaticPagePath for exercise 10 continues to point at the real preserved historical notebook (book/chapters/chapter_10/exercise_10.ipynb, the WP38/WP38R 'Examples and Common Mistakes' notebook), kept for later redesign and never published; fallbackDownloadablePath now points at this WP's own exercise_10_deep_learning_portable.ipynb, the file actually linked from the published page, not the legacy notebook's old portable copy. WP60 (local-only; not yet released, see WPs/reports/WP60_REPORT.md) swaps Exercises 3 and 4's subjects: Exercise 3 is now 'Validation and Cross-Validation' (formerly Exercise 4) and Exercise 4 is now 'Classification and Metrics' (formerly Exercise 3). Both exercises' templateNotebookPath/browserWorkingCopyName/liteUrl moved into a new 'v2/' subdirectory (book/lite/files/v2/exercise_0{3,4}.ipynb, liteUrl path=v2/exercise_0{3,4}.ipynb) -- a fresh, never-before-used JupyterLite contents-path, distinct from the old flat exercise_03.ipynb/exercise_04.ipynb, so a returning student's browser-local saved edits under the old path cannot resurface, silently mislabeled, as the other lesson. A first WP60 draft instead suffixed the filename itself ('exercise_03_v2.ipynb'), which worked for the storage-collision problem but leaked '_v2' into every place JupyterLite displays a document's name (its header, browser-tab title, and the 'Download my notebook' filename) -- confirmed live and corrected during review: JupyterLite derives every visible name from the path's basename only, never its directory, so 'v2/exercise_03.ipynb' displays identically to a plain 'exercise_03.ipynb' everywhere a student can see it, while still being a wholly new, collision-free path. dataAssets and fallbackDownloadablePath/legacyStaticPagePath were swapped/updated to match each exercise's new content.
